audit.whatIsWrong: Hallowed Mist was described as 'she's safe inside it' with the only counterplay being to wait out the cooldown. The actual rule is directional: she is untargetable to anyone OUTSIDE the mist and fully targetable by anyone who steps in. The full layer's don't even tells you not to fight inside the mist, which is backwards — inside is the one place your abilities work.
audit.why: Riot's W text: 'Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.' The mist is 22/21/20/19/18s, so it is not a short window to wait out either.
audit.corrected: The directional rule and the 22s rank-1 cooldown written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], dontsFull[0].d and report[5], with the two real options stated: step in, or Q-pull her out.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 read Skill while whys[0] says 'You actually out-level-1 her', and Levels 4-5 read Skill while whys[3] describes her stacking passive damage and misting out every commit.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Kled / Skill / Gwen / Gwen / Gwen / Gwen / Kled; the mirror flipped Levels 3, 6 and First item to Gwen and left Levels 1-2 and 2+ items to Kled, which the remaining rows already match.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 3 flipped in matched full/content pairs to Kled and Gwen, with the ratings moved with them. Row 1 left as Kled to stay in step with the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: Needlework was written as 'true-damage missiles' in whys[4], spikes[1] and mid. Needlework deals magic damage and slows; the only true damage in Gwen's kit is the centre of Snip Snip! (Q). The full layer also wrote 'Beartrap', used 'his' for Gwen throughout, and never named Skip 'n Slash.
audit.why: Riot's R text: 'hurls a needle that slows enemies hit, deals magic damage, and applies A Thousand Cuts'. Riot's Q text: 'Gwen deals true damage to units in the center'. Riot's E refunds part of its 13s cooldown when she hits something during the buff, so it is rarely fully down.
audit.corrected: True damage moved to where it belongs (Q's centre), Needlework restated as slowing needles with its real 120s cooldown, Skip 'n Slash named with its 13s and its refund, the name and pronouns fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early, mid and late were written in the first person.
audit.why: Breaks the second-person coaching voice the rest of the site uses.
audit.corrected: All three rewritten in second person at the same length, with the mist rule and Grievous Wounds folded in.

edits.before: Beartrap Gwen when his answer is down, rip the full mounted combo, and if dismounted, kite for courage and remount mid-fight.
edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope Gwen once Hallowed Mist is spent, rip the full mounted combo, and if dismounted, kite for courage.

edits.before: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — She’s safe inside it. Fight when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1; from outside you cannot target her, from inside you can. - Skip 'n Slash: 13s, partly refunded when she hits you. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: She’s safe inside it. Fight when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 22s at rank 1. From outside she is untargetable — bait it, then commit.

edits.before: That is Gwen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Only enemies standing inside the mist can target her — step in or pull her out.

edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Eclipse (burst + the all-in sustain), then Sterak's Gage; boots Mercury's Treads. Executioner's Calling early — A Thousand Cuts heals her off you.

edits.after: Needlework (120s) outzones your all-in — slowing needles fired from inside mist, which you can only answer by stepping into it.

edits.before: Her R Needlework outranges and outzones your all-in — three waves of true-damage missiles she fires from inside Hallowed Mist where your trap and E can't touch her.
edits.after: Needlework (120s) outranges your all-in — three waves of slowing needles fired from inside Hallowed Mist, where she is untargetable unless you step in with her.

edits.before: Farm safely with Snip Snip Q and stack her passive Thousand Cuts true damage to out-sustain your trades
edits.after: Farm safely with Snip Snip! (Q) and heal off A Thousand Cuts on you to out-sustain your trades

edits.before: Level 1 is actually mine for once — Gwen has no early poke and her Snip Snip Q only stacks once, so step up and auto her while she has nothing to punish you with. At 2 my Violent Tendencies shotgun shots out-trade her single Q, but the second she pops Hallowed Mist (W) my Bear Trap and E-pull whiff into the cloud, so don't commit a full re-E into a mist that's still up. Bait the mist, then trap her when she steps out to farm or auto.
edits.after: Level 1 is actually yours for once — Gwen has no early poke and her Snip Snip! (Q) only stacks once, so step up and auto her while she has nothing to punish you with. At 2 your Violent Tendencies shotgun shots out-trade her single Q, but the second she pops Hallowed Mist (W) she is untargetable to anything outside it, so don't commit a full re-E into a mist that's still up. Bait the mist, then trap her when she steps out to farm.

edits.before: From 4 onward she's stacking her passive true damage and her trades stop losing to my W. At 6 her Needlework ult is the problem — she sits in Hallowed Mist and rains true-damage missiles I literally cannot reach, so a clean all-in into a full mist + ult is a death sentence. My window is the moment she's out of mist with E on cooldown: trap, yank, dismount-dodge her Snip Snip dash. Don't chase her into the cloud.
edits.after: From 4 onward she stacks her passive and her trades stop losing to your W. At 6 Needlework is the problem — she sits in Hallowed Mist and rains slowing needles while nothing outside the cloud can target her, so an all-in into a full mist plus ult is a death sentence. Your window is the moment she's out of mist with Skip 'n Slash (13s) spent: trap, yank, burst. Don't chase her into the cloud.

edits.before: Once she has Riftmaker or Nashor's, her Snip Snip true damage and untargetable mist out-scale my frontloaded burst — she just W's out of every trap and combo and DPS-races me with true damage my remount can't sustain through. My one shot is catching her stepping out of Hallowed Mist with a clean Q-pull into full Eclipse combo. If I didn't snowball a lead in those early levels, she wins the patient long game — so close it before she gets there.
edits.after: Once she has Riftmaker or Nashor's, her Snip Snip! centre true damage and untargetable mist out-scale your frontloaded burst — she W's out of every trap and DPS-races you while A Thousand Cuts heals her off your health bar. Your one shot is catching her stepping out of Hallowed Mist with a clean Q-pull into the full Eclipse combo, Grievous Wounds already bought. If you didn't snowball early, she wins the long game.

notes: Both packet defects are near-misses rather than inventions: 'Snip Snip' is missing the exclamation mark (Snip Snip!) and 'Thousand Cuts' is missing the article (A Thousand Cuts); I corrected both where they sat inside strings long enough to edit. The genuinely dangerous error was the mist: dontsFull[0].t reads 'Fight inside her W mist' as a mistake to avoid, when entering the mist is the only way to target her at all. That title is 23 characters, under the applier's 25-char skip threshold, so I could not fix it through a proposal — it needs a manual edit to something like 'Stand outside her W mist'. Until then dontsFull[0].t and its corrected .d will read as contradicting each other.
